name: RAG Scheme Eval
description: RAG pipeline built over real Indian government scheme documents (PM-Kisan, PMAY, MGNREGA, PM-JAY, Ujjwala, scholarships), tested against a hand-verified golden question set. Ablates chunking strategy, embedding model, hybrid search, reranking, and generation model (open-source vs. paid API) one at a time, tracking accuracy and cost for each change.
